hints.title: Track Dice Face and Consecutive Run Length
hints.text: State requires the roll step, the current face rolled, and how many consecutive times that face has appeared.

hints.title: Transition Between Different and Same Faces
hints.text: Rolling a different face resets its run length to 1; rolling the same face increments run length if below rollMax.

hints.title: Sum Valid Configurations Modulo 10^9 + 7
hints.text: Advance state round by round and sum all valid configurations across all six faces after n rolls.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def dieSimulator(self, n: int, rollMax: list[int]) -> int:
        MOD = 10**9 + 7
        # dp[face][consecutive_count]
        dp = [[0] * 16 for _ in range(6)]
        for f in range(6):
            dp[f][1] = 1
            
        for _ in range(n - 1):
            nxt = [[0] * 16 for _ in range(6)]
            face_sums = [sum(dp[f]) % MOD for f in range(6)]
            total_sum = sum(face_sums) % MOD
            
            for f in range(6):
                # Different face
                nxt[f][1] = (total_sum - face_sums[f]) % MOD
                # Same face
                for k in range(2, rollMax[f] + 1):
                    nxt[f][k] = dp[f][k - 1] % MOD
            dp = nxt
            
        return sum(sum(dp[f]) for f in range(6)) % MOD
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Branching across six outcomes for n steps yields 6^N sequences.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking face and consecutive counts limits states per roll to 6 * 15.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle face transitions and bound memory to two roll layers modulo 10^9 + 7.
